verdict.rationale: The only SDK evidence is a narrow first-party authentication SDK page for business accounts (device binding), which shows Adyen ships at least one official SDK. Otherwise the pack describes building through raw APIs (Legal Entity Management, Configuration), and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: documented official server-side SDKs/client libraries for the Platforms APIs, language coverage, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
